blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two online platforms were given a deadline by an attached agency of the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) to establish their presence in the country and coordinate with authorities. This is as the government tries to determine the extent of social media’s influence following a third school shooting in three months. Meanwhile, Malacañang said it was open to a lawmaker’s proposal requiring congressional franchises for social media platforms to operate in the country. The DICT’s Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center (CICC) on Tuesday said it had sent letters, both dated Sept.21, to Reddit and Discord, requesting […]...
